description:
The coder extension examples (waves 1-4, opi-hix) each document divergences from the upstream TypeScript harness in their moduledocs. These represent real holes in the extension API / Context / UIContext that prevent full-fidelity ports of the upstream examples.

Each child ticket captures one divergence: the upstream capability, the affected example extension(s), the current workaround, and what needs to be implemented to close the gap.

Source: moduledocs in apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/extensions/*.ex and upstream examples in tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/examples/extensions/.
title: Extension API gaps surfaced by coder extension examples
